property.value:
Force Construction This resource costs 5 points. Blackbird may be played without paying this cost, but if you do, this dial is not used. This resource must be assigned to Blackbird.
Clicking the Dial When you remove an ID Card from the game using its Call In Help ability, you may roll a d6 and turn this resource's dial clockwise that many times. When Blackbird clears action tokens or takes damage from an opposing character's attack, after resolutions, you may turn this resource dial once clockwise.
Scoring If Blackbird is scored, this resource is removed from the game and scored.
I Have Some Time to Help POWER: Choose an ID Character on your sideline of equal or less points than the resource dial indicates. Place that ID Character on the map adjacent to Blackbird, remove that ID Card from the game, then roll a d6, turning this resource dial to the click number matching the result. Add 1 to the result if it's a student ID card. That character is no longer an ID Character, can't use Willpower, and is returned to your sideline if it would take damage.
